metrics.threshold_sweep_type: event positive cutoff; negative cutoff fixed, scores between cutoffs route to review

latency.p95_method: nearest-rank; descriptive only; small-sample estimates are unstable

metrics.note: Pilot corpus metrics only; synthetic and small. Threshold sweep is descriptive and must not be treated as production calibration.

gold_label_status: single-annotator synthetic baseline; metrics are conditional on draft labels
note: Metrics use only successfully validated responses; failed cases are excluded and may create selection bias. The original baseline is synthetic and small, with single-author draft labels that have not been independently adjudicated. These descriptive metrics are neither independent validation nor calibration and do not prove production quality. Segment JSON and the local cumulative-attempt ledger can be modified/reset by the local user; Polza provides no signed response proof in this flow, so API origin is not cryptographically attested. One case is a pinned historical artifact from an earlier client revision; current staged segments record their source hashes. No raw articles, prompts, provider bodies, credentials, or raw error details are included.
